xtrm-a3mn.description:
Research finding: 'Pharaoh – structural codebase maps for AI coding agents' got 87pts on HN — developers want structured codebase summaries for agents.

**Action items:**
1. Add `bd map` command that exports GitNexus context as specialist-readable summaries
2. Create pre-computed 'agent context packs' per service/territory
3. Add `bd context <service>` to show dependency graph for a territory
4. Export maps in JSON format for specialist consumption
5. Wire into specialists run --context-depth to auto-include relevant maps

**Example output:**
```
bd map specialists
# Exports: dependency graph, top 10 symbols, execution flows involving specialists CLI
```

**Why this matters:** Specialists can work more efficiently with pre-computed structural context instead of discovering from scratch.

**Source:** last30days research on AI coding agents (HN: Pharaoh project)
xtrm-a3mn.notes: Release triage 2026-05-04: valuable roadmap work, but not required for the next patch release. Defer until after release-critical bugfix/docs/packaging items land.
xtrm-a3mn.title: Surface GitNexus index as agent-ready codebase maps
